audit_log_platform_insert.name: audit_log_platform_insert
audit_log_platform_insert.withCheck: actor_id IS NULL AND ip_address IS NULL AND action IN ('subscription_changed', 'import_window_changed')

document_imports_confirmation.name: document_imports_confirmation
document_imports_confirmation.value: "document_imports"."confirmed_at" is null or ("document_imports"."confirmed_by" is not null and ("document_imports"."confirmed_by_import" or "document_imports"."confirmation_signature_id" is not null))

email_queue_about_one_thing.name: email_queue_about_one_thing
email_queue_about_one_thing.value: ("email_queue"."category" = 'daily_digest') = ("email_queue"."notification_id" is null and "email_queue"."period" is not null)

notifications_about_one_thing.name: notifications_about_one_thing
notifications_about_one_thing.value: ("notifications"."incident_id" is null or "notifications"."document_id" is null) and ("notifications"."incident_id" is not null or "notifications"."document_id" is not null or "notifications"."kind"::text in ('public_form_paused', 'acknowledgements_overdue_digest', 'email_turned_off', 'signing_pin_changed', 'signing_pin_locked', 'review_approval_turned_off', 'audit_chain_broken', 'policies_import_granted'))
